title: Waterfall
tagline: Waterfall brings NFT data to life using AI agents with OpenSea MCP Server

prizes.title: Best use of Artificial Superintelligence Alliance

description: Waterfall is a tool that brings NFT data to life. It lets users explore live information about NFTs and tokens, create interactive experiences, and engage with the community in fun ways. Waterfall also provides datasets that can be used by developers and collectors to analyze NFT trends, build applications, and make the most of the blockchain ecosystem. This tool makes NFT information accessible, engaging, and easy to use for everyone.
how_its_made: Waterfall is built using fetch.ai to create AI agents that interact with the OpenSea MCP Server to fetch real-time NFT and token data. The collected data is stored and organized into datasets using Ocean Protocol, allowing users to purchase and reuse it for their own applications. By accessing these NFT details, users can build a variety of engaging and entertaining apps.
